title: Lead Product Designer, Growth (Mobile) at Perplexity
summary: Lead Product Designer, Growth (Mobile) at Perplexity
detailed: Perplexity is hiring a Lead Product Designer for Growth on mobile to own the end-to-end user journey across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.
The role requires hands-on prototyping on device, writing SwiftUI in Xcode, and submitting PRs directly to the production codebase.
Responsibilities include designing first-run onboarding, paywalls, pricing structures, upsell flows, and growth experiments for AI-native features like Computer.
The position demands deep fluency in iOS platform conventions, funnel analytics, and data-informed experimentation.
sentences: Checked on the employer’s board 13 Nov, 01:06 UTC.
In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI.
We’ve scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.
Perplexity is looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to own mobile design for Growth.

You'll shape the experiences that bring Perplexity to as many people as possible on the device they reach for first, making software that feels like the future but can be understood and used by anyone in the world today.
Growth design has its own craft and nuance, and so does mobile.

You'll own the highest-leverage moments in the mobile user journey: first-run onboarding and activation, consumer acquisition surfaces, conversion flows, paywalls and pricing, the nudges and upsells that drive adoption of new products and features, and the retention loops that turn first-time users into daily ones.
This is design where a few pixels, a single step, or the timing of a transition can move real numbers, so you'll pair a high craft bar with rigorous experimentation, letting real data guide the work.
You'll do that in the real material: prototyping on device, writing SwiftUI in Xcode, and putting up your own PRs.
You care about clarity, craft, details, and delight as much as you care about growth and impact.

This role is deeply cross-functional: you'll partner closely with our Growth, Product Marketing, mobile engineering, and brand design teams, and you care about everything it takes to make a product great: product, interaction, growth, copywriting, engineering, and marketing.
No Mind the Product account needed.
